page.content:
Co-founder who remained the public face after Nupedia folded.

How Jimmy Wales connects

  • Topic: Wikipedia — Jimmy Wales co-founded Wikipedia and remained its most public advocate.
  • Work: Nupedia — Wales funded Nupedia through Bomis as a free expert encyclopedia.
  • Faction: Wikimedia Foundation — Wales helped establish the Wikimedia Foundation in 2003.

What is Jimmy Wales?

Jimmy Wales funded Nupedia through Bomis, opened Wikipedia in January 2001, and later chaired the Wikimedia Foundation as the project became a global reference.

Key threads lead to Wikipedia, Nupedia and Wikimedia Foundation.
